name: WebGraphEval
description: WebGraphEval is a framework for evaluating web agents by abstracting multi-turn trajectories into a unified weighted action graph. It enables structural analysis of agent behaviors, capturing cross-model regularities and identifying inefficiencies beyond binary success metrics.
reputation: A very recent framework-style benchmark for web agents that is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Compatible with existing benchmarks and supports multi-path, cross-agent evaluation without modifying environments.
